title: skills install/diff: .claude/skills + .agent/skills targets, user and project scope
description:
Human decision (2026-08-12): the two location conventions .claude/skills and .agent/skills cover ~99% of harnesses — support both as first-class install targets instead of a per-harness registry.

Extend tk skills install/diff (read the existing implementation in cmd/tk/cmd/skills*.go + internal/skills first; preserve every existing behavior: stamp, unmanaged refusal, --force, atomic swap, --dir escape hatch):

1. New flag `--to claude|agent` (default claude): claude -> <scope>/.claude/skills/<name>; agent -> <scope>/.agent/skills/<name>.
2. New scope flag `--project` (default is user scope): user scope roots at $HOME (~/.claude/skills, ~/.agent/skills); --project roots at the current repo root (detect the way other commands do) giving ./.claude/skills/<name> or ./.agent/skills/<name>.
3. `--dir` still overrides everything (mutually exclusive with --to/--project: usage error exit 2 via ExitError if combined).
4. diff gains the same flags with identical resolution, so install/diff always pair.
5. Help text documents the resolution table compactly. Registration/ResetFlags/legacy-usage per .tick/learnings.md if any new file is added (extending existing files needs only ResetFlags additions for new flag vars).
6. Tests (temp dirs only, never real $HOME: set HOME to a temp dir the way existing install tests do — read them): all four target×scope cells resolve correctly; --dir + --to = usage error; diff pairs with each cell.
7. Update the README Skills section lines the docs tick just wrote ONLY where the flag surface changed (keep the edit minimal — the docs tick owns the section; you own the flag rows).

Full-suite gate on real exit codes per .tick/config.md Testing; gofmt/vet clean. Commit with message prefix "tick <this-tick-id>: ".
acceptance_criteria: All four --to×scope cells + --dir exclusivity pinned by tests; diff pairs with install on every cell; README flag rows updated; full suite green
